def: Military education and training is a process which intends to establish and improve the capabilities of military personnel in their respective roles.

t: Team building
c: Team sports were used to train and to prove the capability to fight in the military and also to work together as a team (military unit).
def: Team building is a collective term for various interventions that improve team effectiveness and define roles within teams, often involving collaborative tasks.
